description: Deprecated compatibility interface; the replacement is create_asset. Both interfaces access the same Strategy records. Retained for existing clients during migration. Creates a populated draft strategy. Capture guidance and schema are available from get_strategy_template. Validates before saving; success returns the saved link and revision. Supports subsequent refinement through edit_strategy. Requires strategy management rights, including customer moderators. Publication is separate.
name: create_strategy
title: Create strategy
